scope: Instrumentation limits discovered while validating retained evidence; original records remain unchanged

command_logger.implementation: The supplied run.py derives the next record number from the count of completed JSON files before launching a command. Concurrent wrapper processes can choose the same number.
command_logger.consequence: Retained command counts are a lower bound and cannot be used as total tool-call, token or work-cost measurements. Metadata and output hashes must be checked before using a specific record.

observed_at_six_run_checkpoint.interpretation: Consistent with the logger's concurrency collision. This mismatched pair is not used to certify a reading action. The source skill snapshot is independently byte-identical to its registered version; the agent's full-reading assertion remains self-reported where exported records are incomplete.

command_logger.treatment: No original participant log was rewritten, no frozen application was repaired, and no output was excluded. Independent acceptance and capture records are generated by the evaluator into separate directories. Final analysis enumerates all observed digest mismatches.

observed_at_nine_run_checkpoint.issue: Malformed JSON: extra data at line13 column2, char366
observed_at_nine_run_checkpoint.treatment: Original379bytes retained. Excluded from valid command parsing and exact full-reading support; counted separately as malformed metadata.
Original metadata and output retained. This mismatched pair is excluded from exact reading/command-output support.

temporal_wall_time_field.detail: The original temporal script writes its startedAt field at recording completion. This field is not used as an exact clip-start UTC time. Event and sampleStartedMs/sampleEndedMs values are valid relative recording-clock observations and remain the basis for episode evidence.
temporal_wall_time_field.interpretation: Continuous recordings and sampled images are retained; screenshot cadence includes capture overhead, and no FPS or natural-playback review claim is inferred.
